description: Economics: National Ocean Watch (ENOW) Explorer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Coastal Management. Explore economic data that characterize the size and makeup of the ocean economy represented by about 400 counties in the United States. The effective management of coastal resources requires an understanding of the ocean and Great Lakes economy. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
